page_title: LEV 0-2 BIL | Levante v Athletic Bilbao 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Yellow Cards

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.

90+3' A precise low pass is received by Jose Morales (Levante), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
90+1' A pass by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gorka Guruzeta trots off the pitch and is replaced by Izeta (Ath Bilbao).
88' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Alex Berenguer is replaced by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
88' Jose Morales (Levante) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
86' The referee shows the yellow card to Roger Brugue (Levante).
85' A pass from Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Mathew Ryan and the move breaks down.
83' Julian Calero appears to have said too much and referee Adrian Cordero comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
81' Here is a change. Mikel Jauregizar is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
81' A substitution has been made. Nico Williams is replaced by Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao).
79' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
78' A pass by Manu Sanchez (Levante) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
77' Roger Brugue (Levante) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Wow, what an escape. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
75' Ath Bilbao show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
74' One of the players from Levante times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jose Morales (Levante) for Jeremy Toljan.

72' Ambitious effort from Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
70' Oriol Rey (Levante) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Levante will take a throw-in.
66' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Ath Bilbao are taking a throw-in.
64' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) sends a long ball in, but Unai Simon comfortably gathers the ball.
62' Robert Navarro just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replaces him.
62' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
60' Looks like Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
58' Substitution. Alan Matturro makes way for Victor Garcia (Levante).
56' Levante earn a free kick.
56' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
52' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ivan Romero (Levante) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
50' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is given a yellow card.
49' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
46' Julian Calero makes a switch. Roger Brugue is coming on in place of Kervin Arriaga (Levante) at the start of the second period.
46' Julian Calero has made a change at the break. Jorge Cabello has come on in place of Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante).
46' Half-time substitution. Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) will not participate anymore and Ivan Romero is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Carlos Alvarez (Levante), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

45+2' Etta Eyong (Levante) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom right corner. His promising effort is kept out by Unai Simon, who pulls off a stunning save! Now Levante have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 2 What a goal that is! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run and from inside the box he beats Mathew Ryan with a delightful chip. He makes it 0:2.
42' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is about to take a corner kick.
41' A dangerous looking corner kick from Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is cleared to safety by the defence. Corner kick. Levante will have an opportunity.
40' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card!

39' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Adrian Cordero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
38' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' The game is interrupted. Oriol Rey (Levante) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
36' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a throw-in.
35' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
32' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is awarded a yellow card.

31' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
29' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
29' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
28' It seemed like Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

27' That was close by Etta Eyong (Levante)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
25' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Adrian Cordero stops the game and makes a call.
23' Ath Bilbao control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' Etta Eyong (Levante) is caught offside!

19' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
19' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' A raking crossfield pass from Oriol Rey (Levante) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
17' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) picks up an injury.
15' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) sees his long-range effort blocked.
13' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Flag up against Goduine Koyalipou (Levante). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
10' Neat passing move from Levante in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan is quickest to intercept the ball.
6' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
6' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Alex Berenguer, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
2' The referee signals a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Adrian Cordero will officiate today.
